item.title: Awards: 16th German Sustainability Award with JECKYBENG
item.description:
Awards and Recognition
#

16th German Sustainability Award (International Category)
#

In December 2023, HerMin Textile and its long-standing partner JECKYBENG received the 16th German Sustainability Award in the newly introduced international category.

item.title: Bags, Headwear & More
item.description:
From Street to Outdoor
#

In accessory development, the functionality and uniqueness of the fabric are the soul of the brand. Whether the goal is the naturally weathered look of a waxed canvas bag or a 100% recyclable coated cap, the marriage between base fabric and functional finish is key. HerMin provides a one-stop solution from heavy-duty organic cotton canvas and recycled polyester to sophisticated functional coatings.

item.title: Bonded/Lamination Fabrics: Membranes for Waterproof Breathable Performance
item.description:
Membranes and Lamination for Function, Sustainability and Comfort
#

HerMin specializes in bonded and lamination fabrics enhanced by premium membranes and eco-friendly coatings. By combining natural fiber blends with different membrane technologies, the company achieves functionality, sustainability and all-day comfort for outdoor, fashion and accessory applications.

item.title: Branches, Locations and Manufacturing Partners
item.description:
Locations and Manufacturing Network
#

HerMin’s public website lists a Taipei headquarters and describes its Tainan plant and Taiwan-based production. The company does not publish a branch or agent directory on the official site; inquiries are handled through the headquarters.

item.title: Coated Fabrics: Acrylic, Silicone, PU, PET and Beeswax Coatings
item.description:
Advanced Coatings for Waterproofness, Durability and Sustainable Performance
#

HerMin offers advanced coating fabrics with acrylic, PU, silicone, beeswax and eco-friendly PET coatings. These finishes provide waterproofness, durability and distinctive matte, glossy or rubber-like surfaces for bags, outerwear and outdoor equipment.

item.title: Contact Information
item.description:
Contact Information
#

HerMin welcomes inquiries about fabrics, custom development and garment manufacturing. The official Contact Us page provides an online form for project requirements.

item.title: Corporate Solutions: Custom Apparel and Corporate Partnerships
item.description:
You Bring the Vision. We Engineer the Reality.
#

HerMin helps organizations create apparel without needing an in-house fashion team. Whether scaling a fitness franchise, outfitting a tech manufacturing plant or launching a crowdfunding campaign, the company turns rough ideas into premium, wearable products.

item.title: Eco Friendly Fabrics: Organic, Recycled and Plant-Based Textiles
item.description:
Sustainability, from Yarn to Finishing
#

HerMin’s eco-friendly fabrics combine sustainability, performance and innovation, offering a wide range of natural and recycled materials. From organic cotton, Tencel® and sustainable blends to recycled polyester, recycled nylon and plant-based coatings, these fabrics are designed to minimize environmental impact while maintaining quality and functionality. They reflect the company’s commitment to responsible sourcing, biodegradability and eco-conscious innovation.

item.title: Elevated Streetwear & Casual
item.description:
Beyond the Standard Blank
#

The streetwear market is crowded. When everyone is printing logos on the same standard silhouettes, fabric quality and cut become the strongest ways to command a premium price and build brand loyalty. HerMin offers premium fabrics by the roll or full-package garment manufacturing, from ready-to-print blanks to fully custom patterns.

item.title: ESG Information: Sustainability, EZ Dye Technology and Circular Design
item.description:
Sustainability Mission and Vision
#

HerMin’s stated mission is to lead the textile industry toward a truly sustainable future. The company transforms eco-conscious fibers into high-performance fabrics that help brands create stylish, functional and planet-friendly products. Sustainability is embedded in decisions from responsible sourcing and innovative textile technologies to production practices that minimize energy, water and chemical use.

item.title: Exhibitions and Events: Meet HerMin at International Textile Fairs
item.description:
Exhibitions and Events
#

HerMin participates in international textile fairs and design events to present its latest natural functional fabrics and sustainable technologies. Event details below are based on the official blog announcements.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
item.description:
Frequently Asked Questions
#

HerMin publishes application-specific FAQs on its official pages. The answers below consolidate the recurring questions about MOQs, lead times, production, certifications, technologies and customization. Full original answers are available on the official application pages linked at the end.

item.title: Functional Shirting: Stretch, Wrinkle-Free, Anti-Odor and Water-Repellent
item.description:
Water Proof, Anti-Bacteria, Lamination and More
#

HerMin’s functional shirting collection covers a large diversity of shirt fabrics, including stretch, wrinkle-free, anti-odor and water-repellent qualities. These fabrics are suitable for professional shirts, uniforms, travelwear and everyday performance shirting.

item.title: Garment Manufacturing: OEM/ODM from Fabric to Finished Product
item.description:
From Fabric Development to Mass Production
#

HerMin offers full-service garment manufacturing for brands of all sizes, from startups to global labels. The company eliminates miscommunication between fabric mills and sewing factories by providing a single point of contact that handles fabric development and final garment production through trusted factory partners.

item.title: Company History and Background: HerMin Textile Since 1976
item.description:
Company History and Background
#

HerMin Textile Co., Ltd. was founded by Mr. Chen Wen-Jin in 1976, during an era of Taiwan’s economic transformation when the export market began to flourish. In the early stage, HerMin’s Tainan plant mainly focused on the production of woven plaid fabric using all-natural fibers, primarily cotton, followed by silk, linen and wool.

item.title: International Certifications: GOTS, OEKO-TEX, GRS, Higg and OCS
item.description:
International Certifications
#

HerMin Textile displays a set of internationally recognized textile certifications on its official website. These certificates support traceability, responsible sourcing and safer materials for brands and consumers.

item.title: Knitted Fabrics: Sustainable and Functional Knits
item.description:
Sustainable and Functional Knitted Textiles for Indoor and Outdoor Activities
#

HerMin’s knitted fabrics use a range of elastic and natural fibers, including single jersey, interlock, French terry, jacquard and warp knits. They are designed for underwear, yoga, golf and other activewear, combining comfort, shape retention and functional performance.

item.title: Outdoor & Performance Solutions
item.description:
Sustainable Protection from Rain, Wind and Daily Wear
#

Outdoor fabrics provide sustainable protection from rain, wind and daily wear while staying naturally comfortable. HerMin positions itself as a technical partner that balances aesthetics, performance and sustainability, engineering performance wear that feels as natural as it performs.

item.title: Performance Workwear & Corporate Uniforms
item.description:
Engineered for Durability, Designed for Identity
#

For too long, corporate uniforms and workwear have been treated as an afterthought, often using the cheapest, stiffest materials. A uniform is the face of a company, and the people wearing it need to perform through long, demanding shifts. HerMin brings premium textile engineering into the workwear sector.

item.title: Performance Wovens: Weather Protection, Stretch and Durability
item.description:
Engineered for Quality and Function
#

HerMin’s performance wovens are engineered for outdoor gear, workwear, uniforms and technical apparel. The range combines weather protection, stretch, abrasion resistance and comfort, with options from PFC-free water repellency to high-strength Cordura blends.

item.title: Portfolio Cases: Public Sector, Fitness, Corporate and Crowdfunding Projects
item.description:
Portfolio Cases
#

HerMin publishes customer case studies covering public-sector apparel, fitness uniforms, corporate protective workwear and crowdfunding campaigns. These cases show how fabric development, pattern making and garment manufacturing are combined in real projects.

item.title: Premium Underwear & Base Layers
item.description:
The Ultimate Connection to the Skin
#

Underwear and base layers form the most unforgiving category in fashion. These garments sit directly against sensitive skin 24 hours a day, so there is zero room for error. HerMin is the trusted backend for premium European and American underwear brands, providing an end-to-end, boutique-level manufacturing experience.

item.title: Premium Yoga & Athleisure
item.description:
Break Away from Generic Performance Wear
#

Premium yoga and athleisure is one of the most demanding markets in fashion. Consumers pay premium prices expecting a “second-skin” feel, flawless sculpting and durability. HerMin provides proprietary performance fabrics and agile full-package garment manufacturing with specialized Flatlock sewing.

item.title: Product Launches: New Fabrics and Textile Technologies
item.description:
Product Launches
#

HerMin’s product-launch blog covers new fabric platforms, sustainable dyeing technologies and material collections. The list below follows the official publication dates.

item.title: Ready To Wear: Yarn-Dye, Jacquard, Dobby and Refined Shirting
item.description:
Yarn/Piece Dye, Dobby, Jacquard and More
#

HerMin provides a large diversity of fashion and apparel fabrics to help brands complete garment projects. Combining fashion with function, the ready-to-wear collection covers yarn-dyed and piece-dyed fabrics, jacquard, dobby, high-count shirting, leno weave and vintage yarn.

item.title: Special Innovations: BNS Bouncy™, Waterproof Cotton, Wind Resistance and Bio Softshell
item.description:
From Natural to Functional
#

HerMin applies bionic principles to recreate natural features in textiles. These four innovation platforms show how the company combines natural fibers with weaving, yarn and finishing technologies to replace synthetic performance materials.
